chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya, from his father Zakariyya ibn Musa, from Al-Yasa' ibn Abdullah Al-Qummi, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who prays upon a deceased person alone. He said: 'Yes.' I said: 'And two men?' He said: 'Yes, but the other one should stand behind the other, and not stand by his side.'
ai.seo_question: What is the proper standing arrangement for two people praying Salat al-Janazah together?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the flexibility of Salat al-Janazah by confirming that a single person may lead the prayer alone, while specifying that if two individuals participate, they must stand in a single file (one behind the other) rather than side-by-side. This distinction highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the Imamate in funeral prayer is not strictly bound to the congregational formation rules of daily prayers, emphasizing the simplicity and accessibility of the ritual. The ruling underscores the importance of proper physical arrangement to maintain the unity of the prayer even in minimal participation.
